figures.title: Expansion shares rise in Mexico and Vietnam, without a common three-country rise

contract.core_conclusion: Expansion shares rise in Mexico and Vietnam, without a common three-country rise
contract.evidence_chain: Six stacked bars compare pooled type shares; adjacent counts expose every numerator and denominator.

figures.caption: Composition of delivered Manufacturing records, 2014-2017 and 2020-2022. New, Expansion and Co-location sum to each row's n. Mexico's expansion share rises from 37.35% to 51.01%; Vietnam's rises from 18.82% to 31.17%. Thailand moves from 41.24% to 39.62% in this window and the direction is window-sensitive. No inferential tests are shown.

figures.title: China's share rises in Mexico and Vietnam, but annual record counts rise only in Mexico in this window

contract.core_conclusion: China's share rises in Mexico and Vietnam, but annual record counts rise only in Mexico in this window
contract.evidence_chain: Panel a uses China records / all-source Manufacturing records. Panel b annualizes the same China counts to separate composition from volume.

figures.caption: China-sourced Manufacturing records by destination. Shares use all-source records in the same destination and period as denominators. Annual means divide pooled China counts by four pre-period years and three post-period years. Vietnam's China share rises while its annual China record count falls. Thailand's direction of share change is not stable across windows. The descriptive counts do not establish actual capital inflows, production or trade diversion.

figures.title: New records coexist with Expansion records among previously observed parent-host names

contract.core_conclusion: New records coexist with Expansion records among previously observed parent-host names
contract.evidence_chain: Three stacked bars condition on a positive normalized source-parent-host match in the pre period. New counts are 28/107, 13/25 and 4/11.

figures.caption: Type composition of 2020-2022 Manufacturing records whose normalized source-country, Parent_Company and destination-country combination appears in 2014-2017 Manufacturing records. Normalization uses Unicode NFKC, whitespace and case only, without fuzzy name matching. The matched subgroups contain 107, 25 and 11 records for Mexico, Vietnam and Thailand, respectively; 28, 13 and 4 are New. Exact positive name-history matches do not verify enterprise identity, operation, or first entry. The unmatched group is intentionally omitted because absence of observed project history is not entry evidence. Also requiring the same native sector gives New counts of 21/96, 9/20 and 3/9 in this window. Thailand has zero New records in at least one alternative window; this is not a universal three-country result.
